message:
Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
variants=[]
for n in [2,3,5,20,100]:
 xml='<!DOCTYPE doc [<!ENTITY ent "<ns:elem><x/></ns:elem>">]>\n<doc>\n'
 for i in range(n):
  xml+=f'<decl{i} xmlns:ns="urn:ns{i}">&ent;</decl{i}>\n'
 xml+='</doc>'
 variants.append((f'/tmp/cand_n{n}',xml))
# with reader maybe DTDLOAD noent
for path,xml in variants:
 data=(2).to_bytes(4,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'doc.xml\\\n'+xml.encode()+b'\\\n'
 Path(path).write_bytes(data)
 print(path,len(data))
PY
for f in /tmp/cand_n*; do echo ===$f===; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1 /tmp/run_xml_fuzz $f >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; echo rc=$?; grep -m1 -A3 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer' /tmp/e || true; done
